title: S.A.M Custom Playable Race
description: A mod-defined playable race that rides an existing monster body. Registered into a reserved race id (200-255); appears in the character-select race picker, renders as its host body in both third- and first-person, and applies flat attribute/HP/MP bonuses at character creation. A vanilla or mod-less client that loads such a character plays it as Human (graceful degrade).

name.description: Display name shown in the character-select race picker, e.g. "Frostborn".

host_body.description: The existing monster body this race renders as. Only these 18 bodies have a proper first-person arm, so both views are correct.

description.description: Short flavour text for the race (shown in the picker's info panel).

stat_modifiers.description: Flat attribute / HP / MP bonuses added at character creation (may be negative). Vanilla races give no attribute bonuses, so these are the race's whole stat identity.

blood_diet.description: If true, this race sustains on blood instead of food (like a vampire).

starting_spells.description: Innate spells this race knows from creation. Vanilla "SPELL_X" names or your own "namespace:spell".

allies.description: Monster types that will not attack this race, and that this race will not attack, on top of whatever the host body already gets along with. A goatman-bodied race is already left alone by goatmen; this is for relations the host body does NOT have, e.g. ["gnome", "troll"]. Leave it out to inherit the host body's relations unchanged.

enemies.description: Monster types that are always hostile to this race, even ones the host body gets along with. Listing a type in both allies and enemies makes it an enemy, and the game log says so.

limb_models.description: This race's own body, one model per limb, instead of the host body's. host_body still decides the skeleton: the limb offsets, the animation, and which slots exist. These decide what is drawn in each slot. Omit a limb and it keeps the host body's model, so you can replace just a head or the whole body. Every limb except the head is only visible when that armour slot is empty, which is how every race in the game already works.

head.description: The head. This is the one limb no armour ever replaces, so it always shows. Four forms are accepted, in the order they are tried: a path to a model the game already has ("gharbad_head.vox", or the full "models/creatures/..." form if that filename is used by more than one creature); an id you declared in mod.json "models" ("<ns>:name"); a mod-relative path to your own .vox; or a raw model index. Prefer a path: an index says nothing about what it is, and models.txt line N is index N-1, which is easy to get wrong by one. You may also give an object with a "model" key, for consistency with the other slots, but the head has no transform: the engine sets it outside the limb path, so scale/offset/pitch/roll on head are reported and ignored.

torso.description: The chest. Shown bare; a breastplate covers it, exactly as it does for any other race. Four forms are accepted, in the order they are tried: a path to a model the game already has ("gharbad_head.vox", or the full "models/creatures/..." form if that filename is used by more than one creature); an id you declared in mod.json "models" ("<ns>:name"); a mod-relative path to your own .vox; or a raw model index. Prefer a path: an index says nothing about what it is, and models.txt line N is index N-1, which is easy to get wrong by one. Instead of a bare string you may give an object: { "model": "...", "scale": 1.2, "offset": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": -1 }, "pitch": 0, "roll": 0 }. Use that when your race's proportions differ from the host body's and the limb clips or floats; a bare string keeps the host body's proportions.

model.description: The .vox for this limb. Same four forms a bare string accepts.

scale.description: Uniform scale for this limb. 1.0 = the model's own size.

offset.description: Shift the limb in its OWN frame, so it stays correct as the limb swings.

pitch.description: Extra pitch in radians, added to whatever the animation set.

roll.description: Extra roll in radians, added to whatever the animation set.

first_person.description: What YOU see of your own body. Everyone else sees the limb_models above; without this you would see the host body's arms, which is the first thing a player of a custom race notices. Never networked: these are drawn only on your own machine.

arm.description: The forearm/hand that holds your weapon. Also used for the right casting hand, which vanilla draws with the same model.

hand_left.description: The left casting hand, a different model from the arm in every vanilla race too.

extra_limbs.description: Limbs the host body does not have: a tail, wings, horns, extra arms. Barony allocates 29 limb slots per player and uses 16, so there are exactly 13 spare. Drawn on every machine, so all players see them.

attach.description: What it hangs off. body = the player's centre, offset in the direction they face (how the salamander tail works). head = follows the head, like a mask. torso = follows the chest limb.

offset.description: Where to put it, in the direction the player faces.

focal.description: The point the limb rotates around, in its own frame.

yaw_offset.description: Degrees, if the .vox was authored facing a different way.

sway.description: Swing it as the player moves, the way the salamander's tail does. Good for tails, wrong for horns.
